js-text.name: wrote the status message on the main title of the page

js-click.name: Write the code to update the text outside the click callback, and the page will show success as soon as it is opened.

js-class-toggle.name: button returns to light color, aria-pressed remains true

js-counter.name: Put the count initialization into the callback, and it will always display 1 when clicked continuously.

js-input.name: reads the original input, and the greeting retains the spaces on both sides of the name.
